targets.rawSql: WITH filtered_pois AS (SELECT p.id FROM pois p WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL AND (${poi_name_search:sqlstring} = '' OR p.name ILIKE '%' || ${poi_name_search:sqlstring} || '%') AND CASE WHEN ${poi_id_search:sqlstring} = '' THEN true WHEN ${poi_id_search:sqlstring} ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN p.id::text = ${poi_id_search:sqlstring} ELSE false END AND (${poi_category:sqlstring} IN ('', '__all') OR p.category IN (${poi_category:sqlstring}))), filtered_reservables AS (SELECT r.id FROM reservables r WHERE (${show_deleted_reservables:sqlstring} = 'true' OR r.deleted_at IS NULL) AND (${reservable_type:sqlstring} IN ('', 'all') OR r.type = ${reservable_type:sqlstring}) AND (${reservable_vendor:sqlstring} IN ('', '__all') OR r.vendor IN (${reservable_vendor:sqlstring})) AND (${reservable_search:sqlstring} = '' OR r.type || ':' || r.vendor || ':' || r.vendor_id ILIKE '%' || ${reservable_search:sqlstring} || '%' OR coalesce(r.name, '') ILIKE '%' || ${reservable_search:sqlstring} || '%' OR coalesce(r.loop, '') ILIKE '%' || ${reservable_search:sqlstring} || '%' OR coalesce(r.site_type, '') ILIKE '%' || ${reservable_search:sqlstring} || '%') AND (${site_type_search:sqlstring} = '' OR coalesce(r.site_type, '') ILIKE '%' || ${site_type_search:sqlstring} || '%')) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM filtered_pois) AS matching_pois, (SELECT count(*) FROM filtered_pois fp WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reservable_pois rp JOIN reservables r ON r.id = rp.reservable_id WHERE rp.poi_id = fp.id AND r.deleted_at IS NULL)) AS matching_pois_with_reservables, (SELECT count(*) FROM filtered_reservables) AS matching_reservables, (SELECT count(*) FROM availability_snapshot s JOIN filtered_reservables fr ON fr.id = s.reservable_id WHERE s.observed_at >= now() - (${observed_days_back:sqlstring} || ' days')::interval) AS snapshot_rows_in_observed_window, (SELECT max(s.observed_at) FROM availability_snapshot s JOIN filtered_reservables fr ON fr.id = s.reservable_id) AS latest_availability_observed_at;

SELECT p.id AS poi_id, p.name, p.category, p.subcategory, p.source, p.source_id, p.region, ST_X(ST_Centroid(p.geom)) AS lng, ST_Y(ST_Centroid(p.geom)) AS lat, count(DISTINCT r.id) AS reservable_count, max(s.observed_at) AS latest_availability_observed_at FROM pois p LEFT JOIN reservable_pois rp ON rp.poi_id = p.id LEFT JOIN reservables r ON r.id = rp.reservable_id AND r.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN availability_snapshot s ON s.reservable_id = r.id WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL AND (${poi_name_search:sqlstring} = '' OR p.name ILIKE '%' || ${poi_name_search:sqlstring} || '%') AND CASE WHEN ${poi_id_search:sqlstring} = '' THEN true WHEN ${poi_id_search:sqlstring} ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN p.id::text = ${poi_id_search:sqlstring} ELSE false END AND (${poi_category:sqlstring} IN ('', '__all') OR p.category IN (${poi_category:sqlstring})) GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY p.name ASC, p.id ASC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT p.id AS poi_id, p.name, p.category, p.subcategory, p.source, p.source_id, p.region, count(DISTINCT r.id) AS reservable_count, max(s.observed_at) AS latest_availability_observed_at, bool_or(s.available) FILTER (WHERE s.observed_at >= now() - (${observed_days_back:sqlstring} || ' days')::interval) AS any_available_in_window FROM pois p LEFT JOIN reservable_pois rp ON rp.poi_id = p.id LEFT JOIN reservables r ON r.id = rp.reservable_id AND r.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN availability_snapshot s ON s.reservable_id = r.id WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL AND (${poi_name_search:sqlstring} = '' OR p.name ILIKE '%' || ${poi_name_search:sqlstring} || '%') AND CASE WHEN ${poi_id_search:sqlstring} = '' THEN true WHEN ${poi_id_search:sqlstring} ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN p.id::text = ${poi_id_search:sqlstring} ELSE false END AND (${poi_category:sqlstring} IN ('', '__all') OR p.category IN (${poi_category:sqlstring})) GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY p.name ASC, p.id ASC LIMIT 500;

SELECT p.id AS poi_id, p.source, p.source_id, p.category, p.subcategory, p.name, p.region, p.country, p.unit_name, p.reserve_url, p.phone, p.info_url, p.fetched_at, p.updated_at, count(DISTINCT r.id) AS linked_reservables, max(s.observed_at) AS latest_availability_observed_at, now() - max(s.observed_at) AS latest_availability_age, p.provider_ref, p.properties AS raw_properties FROM pois p LEFT JOIN reservable_pois rp ON rp.poi_id = p.id LEFT JOIN reservables r ON r.id = rp.reservable_id AND r.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN availability_snapshot s ON s.reservable_id = r.id WHERE ${poi_id:sqlstring} ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND p.id::text = ${poi_id:sqlstring} GROUP BY p.id;

SELECT r.id AS reservable_id, r.type || ':' || r.vendor || ':' || r.vendor_id AS rid, r.type, r.vendor, r.vendor_id, r.name, r.loop, r.site_type, r.source, r.updated_at, r.deleted_at, max(s.observed_at) AS latest_availability_observed_at, count(s.id) FILTER (WHERE s.observed_at >= now() - (${observed_days_back:sqlstring} || ' days')::interval) AS snapshots_in_window, bool_or(s.available) FILTER (WHERE s.observed_at >= now() - (${observed_days_back:sqlstring} || ' days')::interval) AS any_available_in_window, r.tags FROM reservable_pois rp JOIN reservables r ON r.id = rp.reservable_id LEFT JOIN availability_snapshot s ON s.reservable_id = r.id WHERE ${poi_id:sqlstring} ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND rp.poi_id::text = ${poi_id:sqlstring} AND (${show_deleted_reservables:sqlstring} = 'true' OR r.deleted_at IS NULL) AND (${reservable_type:sqlstring} IN ('', 'all') OR r.type = ${reservable_type:sqlstring}) AND (${reservable_vendor:sqlstring} IN ('', '__all') OR r.vendor IN (${reservable_vendor:sqlstring})) AND (${reservable_search:sqlstring} = '' OR r.type || ':' || r.vendor || ':' || r.vendor_id ILIKE '%' || ${reservable_search:sqlstring} || '%' OR coalesce(r.name, '') ILIKE '%' || ${reservable_search:sqlstring} || '%' OR coalesce(r.loop, '') ILIKE '%' || ${reservable_search:sqlstring} || '%' OR coalesce(r.site_type, '') ILIKE '%' || ${reservable_search:sqlstring} || '%') AND (${site_type_search:sqlstring} = '' OR coalesce(r.site_type, '') ILIKE '%' || ${site_type_search:sqlstring} || '%') GROUP BY r.id ORDER BY r.loop NULLS LAST, r.name NULLS LAST, rid ASC;

WITH filtered AS (SELECT r.* FROM reservables r WHERE (${show_deleted_reservables:sqlstring} = 'true' OR r.deleted_at IS NULL) AND (${reservable_type:sqlstring} IN ('', 'all') OR r.type = ${reservable_type:sqlstring}) AND (${reservable_vendor:sqlstring} IN ('', '__all') OR r.vendor IN (${reservable_vendor:sqlstring})) AND (${reservable_search:sqlstring} = '' OR r.type || ':' || r.vendor || ':' || r.vendor_id ILIKE '%' || ${reservable_search:sqlstring} || '%' OR coalesce(r.name, '') ILIKE '%' || ${reservable_search:sqlstring} || '%' OR coalesce(r.loop, '') ILIKE '%' || ${reservable_search:sqlstring} || '%' OR coalesce(r.site_type, '') ILIKE '%' || ${reservable_search:sqlstring} || '%') AND (${site_type_search:sqlstring} = '' OR coalesce(r.site_type, '') ILIKE '%' || ${site_type_search:sqlstring} || '%') ORDER BY r.type ASC, r.vendor ASC, r.name NULLS LAST, r.vendor_id ASC LIMIT 500) SELECT f.id AS reservable_id, f.type || ':' || f.vendor || ':' || f.vendor_id AS rid, f.type, f.vendor, f.vendor_id, f.name, f.loop, f.site_type, f.source, f.updated_at, f.deleted_at, string_agg(DISTINCT p.id::text || ' - ' || p.name, '; ') FILTER (WHERE p.id IS NOT NULL) AS linked_pois, max(s.observed_at) AS latest_availability_observed_at, bool_or(s.available) FILTER (WHERE s.observed_at >= now() - (${observed_days_back:sqlstring} || ' days')::interval) AS any_available_in_window, f.tags FROM filtered f LEFT JOIN reservable_pois rp ON rp.reservable_id = f.id LEFT JOIN pois p ON p.id = rp.poi_id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN availability_snapshot s ON s.reservable_id = f.id GROUP BY f.id, f.type, f.vendor, f.vendor_id, f.name, f.loop, f.site_type, f.source, f.updated_at, f.deleted_at, f.tags ORDER BY f.type ASC, f.vendor ASC, f.name NULLS LAST, f.vendor_id ASC;

WITH selected AS (SELECT r.* FROM reservables r WHERE r.type || ':' || r.vendor || ':' || r.vendor_id = ${reservable_rid:sqlstring}), linked AS (SELECT rp.reservable_id, string_agg(p.id::text, ', ' ORDER BY p.id) AS linked_poi_ids, string_agg(p.id::text || ' - ' || p.name, '; ' ORDER BY p.name, p.id) AS linked_pois FROM reservable_pois rp JOIN pois p ON p.id = rp.poi_id WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY rp.reservable_id) SELECT s.id AS reservable_id, s.type || ':' || s.vendor || ':' || s.vendor_id AS rid, s.type, s.vendor, s.vendor_id, s.name, s.loop, s.site_type, s.source, s.created_at, s.updated_at, s.deleted_at, now() - s.updated_at AS catalog_age, linked.linked_poi_ids, linked.linked_pois, s.provider_ref, s.tags, s.raw FROM selected s LEFT JOIN linked ON linked.reservable_id = s.id;

WITH selected AS (SELECT id FROM reservables WHERE type || ':' || vendor || ':' || vendor_id = ${reservable_rid:sqlstring}), latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.target_date) s.target_date, s.status::text AS observed_status, s.available, s.observed_at, now() - s.observed_at AS observation_age, s.run_id, jr.status AS run_status, s.day_payload FROM availability_snapshot s LEFT JOIN availability_job_run jr ON jr.id = s.run_id WHERE s.reservable_id = (SELECT id FROM selected) AND s.observed_at >= now() - (${observed_days_back:sqlstring} || ' days')::interval AND CASE WHEN ${target_start_date:sqlstring} = '' THEN true WHEN ${target_start_date:sqlstring} ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$' THEN s.target_date >= NULLIF(${target_start_date:sqlstring}, '')::date ELSE false END AND CASE WHEN ${target_end_date:sqlstring} = '' THEN true WHEN ${target_end_date:sqlstring} ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$' THEN s.target_date < NULLIF(${target_end_date:sqlstring}, '')::date ELSE false END ORDER BY s.target_date, s.observed_at DESC, s.id DESC) SELECT target_date, observed_status, available, observed_at, observation_age, run_id, run_status, day_payload FROM latest ORDER BY target_date ASC;

panels.description: Each row is a reservation target date. Each cell is the status from one observation time, so this shows whether a selected reservable's availability changed over recent fetches.

targets.rawSql: WITH selected AS (SELECT id FROM reservables WHERE type || ':' || vendor || ':' || vendor_id = ${reservable_rid:sqlstring}) SELECT s.observed_at AS time, s.target_date::text AS metric, CASE COALESCE(s.status::text, CASE WHEN s.available THEN 'available' ELSE 'unknown' END) WHEN 'available' THEN 4 WHEN 'first_come' THEN 3 WHEN 'reserved' THEN 2 WHEN 'booked' THEN 2 WHEN 'closed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS value FROM availability_snapshot s WHERE s.reservable_id = (SELECT id FROM selected) AND s.observed_at >= now() - (${observed_days_back:sqlstring} || ' days')::interval AND CASE WHEN ${target_start_date:sqlstring} = '' THEN true WHEN ${target_start_date:sqlstring} ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$' THEN s.target_date >= NULLIF(${target_start_date:sqlstring}, '')::date ELSE false END AND CASE WHEN ${target_end_date:sqlstring} = '' THEN true WHEN ${target_end_date:sqlstring} ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$' THEN s.target_date < NULLIF(${target_end_date:sqlstring}, '')::date ELSE false END ORDER BY s.observed_at ASC, s.target_date ASC;

targets.rawSql: WITH linked AS (SELECT r.id AS reservable_id, r.type || ':' || r.vendor || ':' || r.vendor_id AS rid, r.name, r.loop, r.site_type FROM reservable_pois rp JOIN reservables r ON r.id = rp.reservable_id WHERE ${poi_id:sqlstring} ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND rp.poi_id::text = ${poi_id:sqlstring} AND (${show_deleted_reservables:sqlstring} = 'true' OR r.deleted_at IS NULL) AND (${reservable_type:sqlstring} IN ('', 'all') OR r.type = ${reservable_type:sqlstring}) AND (${reservable_vendor:sqlstring} IN ('', '__all') OR r.vendor IN (${reservable_vendor:sqlstring})) AND (${reservable_search:sqlstring} = '' OR r.type || ':' || r.vendor || ':' || r.vendor_id ILIKE '%' || ${reservable_search:sqlstring} || '%' OR coalesce(r.name, '') ILIKE '%' || ${reservable_search:sqlstring} || '%' OR coalesce(r.loop, '') ILIKE '%' || ${reservable_search:sqlstring} || '%' OR coalesce(r.site_type, '') ILIKE '%' || ${reservable_search:sqlstring} || '%') AND (${site_type_search:sqlstring} = '' OR coalesce(r.site_type, '') ILIKE '%' || ${site_type_search:sqlstring} || '%')), latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (l.reservable_id, s.target_date) l.rid, l.name, l.loop, l.site_type, s.target_date, s.status::text AS observed_status, s.available, s.observed_at, now() - s.observed_at AS observation_age, s.run_id FROM linked l JOIN availability_snapshot s ON s.reservable_id = l.reservable_id WHERE s.observed_at >= now() - (${observed_days_back:sqlstring} || ' days')::interval AND CASE WHEN ${target_start_date:sqlstring} = '' THEN true WHEN ${target_start_date:sqlstring} ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$' THEN s.target_date >= NULLIF(${target_start_date:sqlstring}, '')::date ELSE false END AND CASE WHEN ${target_end_date:sqlstring} = '' THEN true WHEN ${target_end_date:sqlstring} ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$' THEN s.target_date < NULLIF(${target_end_date:sqlstring}, '')::date ELSE false END ORDER BY l.reservable_id, s.target_date, s.observed_at DESC, s.id DESC) SELECT rid, name, loop, site_type, target_date, observed_status, available, observed_at, observation_age, run_id FROM latest ORDER BY target_date ASC, loop NULLS LAST, name NULLS LAST, rid ASC LIMIT 1000;

WITH selected AS (SELECT id FROM reservables WHERE type || ':' || vendor || ':' || vendor_id = ${reservable_rid:sqlstring}) SELECT s.id AS snapshot_id, s.run_id, jr.status AS run_status, s.observed_at, s.target_date, s.status::text AS observed_status, s.available, s.day_payload FROM availability_snapshot s LEFT JOIN availability_job_run jr ON jr.id = s.run_id WHERE s.reservable_id = (SELECT id FROM selected) AND s.observed_at >= now() - (${observed_days_back:sqlstring} || ' days')::interval AND CASE WHEN ${target_start_date:sqlstring} = '' THEN true WHEN ${target_start_date:sqlstring} ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$' THEN s.target_date >= NULLIF(${target_start_date:sqlstring}, '')::date ELSE false END AND CASE WHEN ${target_end_date:sqlstring} = '' THEN true WHEN ${target_end_date:sqlstring} ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$' THEN s.target_date < NULLIF(${target_end_date:sqlstring}, '')::date ELSE false END ORDER BY s.observed_at DESC, s.target_date ASC, s.id DESC LIMIT 300;

targets.rawSql: WITH selected AS (SELECT vendor_id, provider_ref->>'mapId' AS map_id, provider_ref->>'resourceLocationId' AS resource_location_id FROM reservables WHERE type || ':' || vendor || ':' || vendor_id = ${reservable_rid:sqlstring}), needles AS (SELECT value FROM selected CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES (vendor_id), (map_id), (resource_location_id)) AS raw(value) WHERE value IS NOT NULL AND value <> '') SELECT namespace, cache_key, created_at, expires_at, now() - created_at AS age, expires_at - now() AS freshness_remaining, expires_at <= now() AS expired, payload_bytes FROM grafana_api_cache_metadata WHERE namespace IN ('recgov_availability', 'aspira_availability', 'aspira_occupancy') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM needles WHERE grafana_api_cache_metadata.cache_key ILIKE '%' || needles.value || '%') ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100;

list.name: poi_category
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT category AS __text, category AS __value FROM pois WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY category ASC

list.name: poi_id
list.query: WITH matches AS (SELECT p.id::text || ' - ' || p.name || ' [' || p.category || ']' AS __text, p.id::text AS __value, p.name, p.id FROM pois p WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL AND (${poi_name_search:sqlstring} = '' OR p.name ILIKE '%' || ${poi_name_search:sqlstring} || '%') AND CASE WHEN ${poi_id_search:sqlstring} = '' THEN true WHEN ${poi_id_search:sqlstring} ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN p.id::text = ${poi_id_search:sqlstring} ELSE false END AND (${poi_category:sqlstring} IN ('', '__all') OR p.category IN (${poi_category:sqlstring})) ORDER BY p.name ASC, p.id ASC LIMIT 500) SELECT __text, __value FROM matches UNION ALL SELECT 'No matching POI' AS __text, '__none' AS __value WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM matches)

list.name: reservable_vendor
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT vendor AS __text, vendor AS __value FROM reservables WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY vendor ASC

list.name: reservable_rid
list.query: WITH matches AS (SELECT r.type || ':' || r.vendor || ':' || r.vendor_id AS rid, coalesce(r.name, 'unnamed') AS display_name, r.loop, r.vendor_id FROM reservables r WHERE r.deleted_at IS NULL AND (${reservable_type:sqlstring} IN ('', 'all') OR r.type = ${reservable_type:sqlstring}) AND (${reservable_vendor:sqlstring} IN ('', '__all') OR r.vendor IN (${reservable_vendor:sqlstring})) AND (${reservable_search:sqlstring} = '' OR r.type || ':' || r.vendor || ':' || r.vendor_id ILIKE '%' || ${reservable_search:sqlstring} || '%' OR coalesce(r.name, '') ILIKE '%' || ${reservable_search:sqlstring} || '%' OR coalesce(r.loop, '') ILIKE '%' || ${reservable_search:sqlstring} || '%' OR coalesce(r.site_type, '') ILIKE '%' || ${reservable_search:sqlstring} || '%') AND (${site_type_search:sqlstring} = '' OR coalesce(r.site_type, '') ILIKE '%' || ${site_type_search:sqlstring} || '%') AND (${rid_scope:sqlstring} = 'all' OR NOT (${poi_id:sqlstring} ~ '^[0-9]+$') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reservable_pois rp WHERE rp.reservable_id = r.id AND rp.poi_id::text = ${poi_id:sqlstring})) ORDER BY display_name ASC, r.loop NULLS LAST, r.vendor_id ASC LIMIT 500) SELECT rid || ' - ' || display_name AS __text, rid AS __value FROM matches UNION ALL SELECT 'No matching reservable' AS __text, '__none' AS __value WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM matches)
